enchantments.tooltip: Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Deception +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to hit and +6 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Accuracy +9: Passive: +9 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Deadly +5: +5 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Vulkoor's Chosen: 2 Pieces Equipped:+10 Artifact bonus to Poison Resistance+1 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice+1 Artifact bonus to Saving Throws+1 Artifact bonus to Dexterity and Constitution
